parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of a display, primarily made of glass with a rectangular shape.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays visual output from the connected device, such as images, videos, or text.
parts.Movement_description: The screen itself is fixed and does not move independently, though it may tilt slightly depending on the stand design.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of durable plastic, providing support and stability.
parts.Functional_description: The base supports the screen and keeps the display upright on a flat surface.
parts.Movement_description: The base is stationary and does not move, though it may allow the screen to tilt or swivel depending on the design.
